rows.text: The Council's website reproduces the law under the heading of King Fahd's royal order number A/91 dated 27/8/1412 AH. Its clauses match the Bureau's text, including application within six months of publication and publication in the official gazette.
rows.locator: Page head (الرقم أ/91، التاريخ 27/8/1412هـ); clauses First to Fifth

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: As served in June 2001, Article 3 reads 'a Chairman and one hundred and twenty members chosen by the King'. Article 10 has the Chairman, his deputy and the Secretary-General appointed and relieved by royal orders; Article 11 requires the oath before the King before they begin work; Article 13 sets a four-Hijri-year term from the date in the forming order.

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair). Appointment orders, stated effective days, stated first days in office, oaths, council-formation orders, term starts and openings, acting presiding, deaths, translations, republications and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The C01-06 king, crown-prince and prime-minister roles are outside this extract.
